# Agent testing (web)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

Checking the AI: golden runs, the Verifier, retrieval and history, one component per tab.

## Files

- `AgentGoldenTab.vue`: Agent testing > Golden Dataset: use cases with known right answers, run against an agent and scored, with the Verifier's verdicts when asked.
- `AgentHistoryTab.vue`: Agent testing > History: past golden runs and Verifier measurements.
- `AgentRetrievalTab.vue`: Agent testing > Retrieval: how well the knowledge base finds the right passage for a fixed set of questions (recall and MRR, by keyword and by meaning).
- `AgentTestingPage.vue`: Agent testing: regression tests for the AI agents themselves.
- `AgentVerifierTab.vue`: Agent testing > Verifier: which model checks drafts, live checks, and how far it agrees with people's labelled judgements (measured before anyone relies on it).
- `agent-testing-data.ts`: What the Agent testing tabs share: the shape of GET /agent-testing, number formats and the providers a person can pick a model from.

## Pages

| Address | Page |
|---|---|
| `/agent-testing/:tab(golden|verifier|retrieval|history)` | `AgentTestingPage.vue` |

The server side is in [`apps/server/src/agent-testing`](../../../../server/src/agent-testing/README.md).
